statistical_plan.attacker_share_scope: Attack-present scenarios only; never average undefined all-empty rewards away
statistical_plan.bootstrap_method: Fixed-seed percentile bootstrap of seed means with exact rational arithmetic and linear percentile interpolation; sample SD is also reported
statistical_plan.bootstrap_unit: Complete seed, jointly across compared rules and scenarios
statistical_plan.honest_cost_scope: Primary paired tests use attack-present conditions; also report honest-cost summaries including attack-free training
statistical_plan.interpretation: Scenario-level tests summarize the fixed experimental conditions and do not establish independence of conditions sharing seeds or population-wide security guarantees
statistical_plan.long_run_policy: Analyze the long runs separately; do not combine them with the main-round horizon to increase the sample count
statistical_plan.multiple_testing: One Holm family of eight comparisons: two extensions by B1/Mstar by attacker share/honest false penalties; missing tests retain their family slots
statistical_plan.paired_tests: Two-sided exact conditional Wilcoxon over attacked main condition-seed pairs; separate complete-seed-mean sensitivity
statistical_plan.scenario_policy: One attack-free condition, one fixed five-over-thirty mixture, and the other attacks at each declared fraction; no duplicate fraction labels
statistical_plan.seed_check: Also report the paired test on complete seed-level pooled differences; with five nonzero pairs its minimum two-sided exact p-value is 0.0625
statistical_plan.undefined_policy: Retain undefined metrics and their counts; require all planned seeds for each reported confidence interval; do not impute an evaluation reward share
